verdict.rationale: Veriff offers webhooks (decision, event, watchlist-screening) that fire on verification-related events, giving a basic event-trigger mechanism, but there is no evidence of a rules engine where a user can define conditional logic (e.g., 'if X then trigger Y') inside Veriff itself — automation logic must be built entirely on the receiving end. Missing for 10: in-platform rule/condition builder, support for chained or conditional actions, and any UI/API for defining custom triggers beyond simple webhook subscription.
